description: 2weeks-spec.md section 6.2 item 1 specifies GET /health as simply returning 200. But REQ-BILL-032 in the behavioral spec adds a PostgreSQL health check requirement (200 when DB healthy, 503 when unavailable). While this is a reasonable enhancement, it also contradicts the source spec. The implementation-design-mvp.md section 3.1 lists GET /health output as '200' with error '503（依存障害時）', which confirms the dependency check. However, the behavioral spec should note this interpretation explicitly since the 2weeks-spec main text is ambiguous.

evidence.snippet: WHEN GET /health is received THE SYSTEM SHALL respond 200 if all dependencies (PostgreSQL) are reachable, and 503 if any dependency is unavailable

remediation: No change required since implementation-design-mvp.md confirms the dependency check behavior. This is informational only.
